mapper.insert: insert into delivery_order (order_id, merchant_id, deliveryman_id, status, accept_time, pickup_time, delivered_time, create_time, update_time) values (#{orderId}, #{merchantId}, #{deliverymanId}, #{status}, #{acceptTime}, #{pickupTime}, #{deliveredTime}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: update delivery_order set deliveryman_id = #{deliverymanId}, status = 'ACCEPTED', accept_time = #{now}, update_time = now() where order_id = #{orderId} and status = 'WAITING'
mapper.select: select d.*, o.number as order_number, o.delivery_fee as delivery_fee, m.shop_name as shop_name, m.phone as merchant_phone, m.address as pickup_address, o.address as receiver_address, o.consignee as consignee, o.phone as phone from delivery_order d left join orders o on o.id = d.order_id left join merchant m on m.id = d.merchant_id where d.status = 'WAITING' order by d.create_time asc
select count(*) from delivery_order where status = 'WAITING'
select count(*) from delivery_order where deliveryman_id = #{deliverymanId} and status = #{status}
